Buro / Real repository evaluation

One migration.
Two model-driven implementations.

Qwen 35B and Flint 40B migrate the same shared UI module from the same commit. This report compares observed changes, verification, cost and the way each agent worked.

RTX 3060 · 12 GB VRAM · 32 GB RAMThinking enabled

Follow-up: a real repository task with autonomous review

ResultsAnalysisCode comparisonTeam & actionsVerificationMethod

Measured results

The task moves BrandMark, ThemePreview and Panel to src/shared/ui, adds public exports and an alias, and updates consumers while preserving their rendered markup.

Speed is not task completion. Decoder throughput includes thinking tokens and excludes prompt evaluation, model loading, tools and waits. Whole-task time includes them; dependency preparation is shown separately. Each model has one run. Elapsed time for an interrupted run is not a completion time. Check counts are task-specific acceptance checks, not general coding scores.

    Method and limits
    
        
    
          
    
            Both runs use Ollama over the direct LAN, one model at a time, 32,768 context tokens,
            8,192 output tokens per request, temperature 0.6, top-p 0.95, presence penalty 0,
            capacity 1 and retries 0. Collaborators inherit the same available model. The task
            allows delegation but does not prescribe roles or a team size.
          
    
          
    
            Each run starts from commit  in an independent Git worktree.
            Dependencies and browser binaries are provided equally. The parent checks structure,
            scope, native UI rendering equivalence, lint, formatting, types, tests and a production
            build.
          
    
          
    
            The six rendering cases compare server-rendered HTML for the original components and
            migrated public exports. They provide evidence of markup preservation; they are not
            exhaustive UI or accessibility coverage. Exact repeated reads count identical
            read_file arguments, not all semantically redundant investigation. Tool
            failures include environment and command failures, not just code defects.
          
    
          
    
            One run per model cannot establish general coding scores or a reliable ranking. Results
            apply to this migration and configuration. The 15-token/s target is a model-selection
            preference, not a runtime restriction.
